channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: 'India soon to become world's third-largest economy,' say BJP leaders, hailing PM Modi's leadership
item.description: Bihar BJP State President Sanjay Saraogi highlighted India's current progress, stating, "Certainly, under the leadership of the Prime Minister, we are now the fourth-largest economy in the world. This fourth-largest economy is above the British, to whom we were once enslaved. Today, the British are below us, and we are ahead of England. Our ancestors could not have even imagined this. Under the esteemed Prime Minister's leadership, India is set to become the third-largest economy."

item.title: Fake railway jobs scam exposed in Kashmir; 'victim' turns out to be mastermind
item.description: A fake Railway recruitment racket in Kashmir has been exposed after investigators found that one of the complainants was in fact the mastermind behind the scam.

item.title: FII selling puts pressure on rupee as domestic flows support equities: Report
item.description: The report from JM Financial noted that the rupee depreciated about 6 per cent in 2025 compared to the historical average annual depreciation of roughly 3.5 per cent, citing FII outflows and trade‑deal overhang with the US.

item.title: Open defecation, child marriage persist in North K'taka despite schemes: Siddaramaiah
item.description: The Chief Minister stated that the government has allocated funds to construct toilets, noting that under the Jal Jeevan Mission, taps have been installed and a water supply is being provided.

item.title: Indian markets remain resilient raising Rs 9.7 lakh crore in H1 FY26: Report
item.description: As many as 122 new listings including 54 on the mainboard and 68 on the SME platform added about Rs 4.1 lakh crore in market capitalisation, the exchange said rounding up the market activity in 2025.

item.title: CDSCO labs flag 205 drug samples as 'not of standard quality' in November
item.description: While the Central Drugs Laboratories identified 64 drug samples as NSQ, the State Drugs Testing Laboratories identified 141 drug samples as NSQ.

item.title: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla highlights 111 pc productivity as Parliament session ends
item.description: Speaker Birla, in a message on X, said that 15 sittings were held during the Parliament session. The total sitting hours during the session was 92 hours and 25 minutes, including a discussion on the national song "Vande Mataram" that lasted 11 hours and 32 minutes.

item.title: 'Rs 39,000 crore meant for Dalits used for guarantees': K'taka BJP demands Minister's resignation
item.description: Addressing a press conference here on Friday, Leader of Opposition in the Legislative Council, Chalavadi Narayanaswamy, demanded the immediate resignation of Minister Mahadevappa, accusing him of betraying the Dalit community instead of working for its welfare.

item.title: J&K CM, PDP, separatists seek action against Bihar CM over viral niqab row
item.description: Political parties and separatist groups in the Kashmir Valley have demanded action against Bihar CM Nitish Kumar over a viral video allegedly showing him pulling down a Muslim woman doctor's niqab during an official function. PDP leader Iltija Mufti lodged an FIR in Srinagar, while CM Omar Abdullah sought an apology, and Mirwaiz Umar Farooq condemned the act.

item.title: Gaurav Khanna visibly embarrassed by Akanksha's "drunk" behaviour at party [reactions]
item.description: At the recent success party, Akanksha was trolled for dancing her heart out despite Gaurav asking her to first make an entry into the venue. As she appeared to lose control of her moves while dancing, several netizens assumed that she was drunk.
